questions.q: In gradient descent, a weight currently has value \( w = 10 \). If the gradient of the loss is \( \frac{\partial L}{\partial w} = 4 \) and the learning rate is \( \eta = 0.1 \), find the updated weight \( w' \).
questions.answer: Using the gradient descent update rule: \( w' = w - \eta \frac{\partial L}{\partial w} = 10 - (0.1)(4) = 10 - 0.40 = 9.60 \).

questions.q: Consider the scalar loss function \( L(w) = 2w^2 - 8w + 5 \). Find the analytical gradient \( \nabla L(w) \) evaluated at \( w = 2 \).
questions.answer: Differentiate with respect to \( w \): \( \frac{dL}{dw} = 2(2)w - 8 = 4w - 8 \). At \( w = 2 \): \( \nabla L = 4(2) - 8 = 8 - 8 = 0 \).

questions.q: Consider the scalar loss function \( L(w) = 3w^2 - 8w + 5 \). Find the analytical gradient \( \nabla L(w) \) evaluated at \( w = 4 \).
questions.answer: Differentiate with respect to \( w \): \( \frac{dL}{dw} = 2(3)w - 8 = 6w - 8 \). At \( w = 4 \): \( \nabla L = 6(4) - 8 = 24 - 8 = 16 \).
